name: demo-placeholders
title: Demo: a third-party box with placeholders (version 2)
about: DEMO data, not a real collection. A creator's box in version 2 that chooses the placeholders add-on (F55: placeholders are general) and one edition-specials series.
Version 2 needs a deadline (BC-045). How outstanding tickets exit at a failure is open (FLR-08 to FLR-11, S11): validate() accepts the combination, nothing is built.

The creator takes the whole reward side (F68 (3), qStream and tStream TO_CREATOR): 10/15 of the fees to the creator, 3/15 to FIT buy-and-burn, 2/15 into the box's own pool depth; and buys 0.1 ETH before the open (F61 O2), shown on the box page.
